Brief introduction:

-------

💬 A new concept, highly customizable, green, safe, and fully serviced dynamic screen sight

Recoil_Tracer is a screen alignment tool developed for a wide range of FPS games.

  • RT_CrH adheres to the concept of green gaming and fair competition, utilizing the window top principle to achieve functions without modifying game content or monitoring progress.

  • RT_CrH supports dozens of customization options, including Alpha channel reticle drawing, size, transparency, position, hotkeys, custom reticle, and many other functions. Please fully unleash your imagination, showcase your personality, and make the reticle truly match you!

  • Although the RT_CrH team is small, they have all the necessary components. Developed by one person, they have a comprehensive after-sales and consulting system, dedicated to serving you wholeheartedly!

Self advantages:

-------

💫 What are the features of RT_CrH (Precise)? Where is the strength?

  • Green and safe, utilizing the principle of a top mounted window to achieve powerful dynamic trajectory functionality without monitoring game progress or modifying any data.

  • More timely answers, enthusiastic treatment of users, striving to meet their needs, harmonious atmosphere within the group, and comprehensive and detailed user manuals, video demonstrations, allowing you to score without any obstacles!

  • More personalized settings, the program includes various customization and saving functions such as crosshair position, crosshair size, crosshair style, style naming, crosshair transparency, locking any window, binding various hotkeys, etc. It supports all resolutions and window sizes, and supports custom dynamic trajectories, truly achieving "matching" with you!

  • You can choose the quantity, support multiple openings, support independent operation, and achieve different special visual effects through multiple crosshairs.

  • More comprehensive in functionality, gathering ideas from users during operation, constantly expanding, and aspiring to become the "culmination" of the most comprehensive screen alignment industry.

-------

Thank you for your support!
detailed_description:
💬Precautions&Frequently Asked Questions

Is the crosshair not displaying?

-------

💡 Due to the exclusive use of graphics cards in full screen mode for some large games, the operation of Recoil_Track&Precise relies on the full screen/frameless window mode of some large games, while non large online games support full screen.

Due to the large number of games, users are advised to set the full screen/borderless window mode for related games on Baidu.

✨It may be a little troublesome and cause some frame rate problems, but the overhead window mode is definitely the safest way to achieve the green guide, and it can easily achieve the full screen size guide. When the author developed this program, he was only a senior high school student, with limited technology, insufficient funds and poor skills. He was driven by his hobbies to update the program, and could not think of other excellent solutions for the time being.

Is the interface garbled?

-------

💡 Due to limitations in programming language and other aspects, Recoil_Tracker&Precise cannot support Unicode characters well. To solve the problem of garbled characters, it is necessary to modify the system language area settings.

  • Open the computer's Start menu [Win key] and open Settings in the bottom left corner.

  • Select "Time and Language" and choose the language on the left.

  • Click on "Manage Language Settings" in the "Related Settings" section on the right, and then click on "Change System Regional Settings" at the bottom of the pop-up window.

  • In the pop-up window, select Chinese (Simplified, China) from the drop-down menu under "Current System Regional Settings", and uncheck "Beta Version: Provides global language support using Unicode UTF-8" below.

Change resolution?

-------

💡 Due to the temporary inability to support full screen exclusivity, the steps required to change the game resolution in full screen window mode for Recoil_Tracker&Precise are slightly complicated. Please follow the steps below.

  • Preliminary settings (only need to be set once):

    • N-card user:

      • Open the NVIDIA Control Panel.

      • [Display] - [Adjust desktop size and position] Check [Full screen] and [Overwrite zoom mode set by game and program] and apply.

    • A-card user:

      • Open AMD Software.

      • [Display] - [Turn on GPU Zoom] - [Zoom Mode] Change to [Full Panel] and apply.

  • Program settings:

    • Fill in the desired resolution (i.e. game resolution) under [Auxiliary Settings] - [Resolution] - [Preset Resolution], and click [Apply].

    • After playing, you can click on [Restore] at the same location to restore the initial resolution.

-------

🌟!! This paragraph is sourced from the official website. For more help, please go to the official website help center on the right or obtain it through contact information!! 🌟
